text: My fellow citizen, the war that I so sorrowfully endured, the Civil War, did indeed come to an end on April 9th, 1865. It was a day that marked the fall of our great city, Richmond, the capital of the rebellious states, and the final surrender of General Robert E. Lee's army to General Ulysses S. Grant at Appomattox Courthouse in Virginia. 'Twas a moment of great relief and solemn reflection, a testament to the sacrifice and perseverance of our nation, and the weight of responsibility, though I fear, weighed heavily upon my own shoulders as I walked in the footsteps of so many who fought for what we held dear.
